description: This file defines the class AdoNetReminderTable which implements the IReminderTable interface for managing reminder data through an ADO.NET storage backend in Orleans. It includes methods for initialization, reading, upserting, and removing reminder entries, as well as clearing the table for testing purposes.

classes.name: AdoNetReminderTable
classes.description: Implements reminder table management via ADO.NET in Orleans, providing methods to initialize, read, insert, delete, and clear reminder data.

methods.name: AdoNetReminderTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the reminder table with cluster and storage options.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Orleans queries object asynchronously.

methods.name: ReadRows (GrainId)
methods.description: Reads reminder rows associated with a specific GrainId.

methods.name: ReadRows (uint, uint)
methods.description: Reads reminder rows within a hash range.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder row by grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder row, adjusting the StartAt time to UTC if unspecified.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder row based on grain ID, reminder name, and eTag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears all reminder rows in the table for testing purposes.
